title: docs(pm-dispatch): write the maintainer's p3 first-touch standard into triage grading and narrow review follow-up cards to it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9KWVourUrFbNxeXrbEEfx51)_
Fixes #34153
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** ① 分诊定级块写进您 11-15 定的 p3 首触标准:无客户/用户影响、读数过时/被取代/已交付、无人实测可达的边角,一律逐张写理由关 not_planned;用户可见缺陷、已发布文档与技能文本、安全项、您直派的、open PR 承载或席位已接的留下。② 立卡门:合「关」条的复审 nit 与范围外发现只写进该 PR 自己的记录,不再立卡。③ 裁决 B 收窄:每 PR 一张「复审尾巴清单卡」与区域 loose ends 卡只收合「留」条的项,清单为空就不立卡。
- **为什么改:** 标准原来只写在分诊巡查任务里,各席位照旧把复审小问题单独立卡、分诊再首触关掉,来回空转;裁决 B 的清单卡收的恰是标准要关的条目。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改两份内部规则文本(各 +6/−6 行内,行数持平);为付行数删了 4 行在别处另有家的规则,家逐条列在下方。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `references/triage-duties.md` 第 56–59 行(标准本身);`references/filing-gate.md` 第 34 行(立卡门与裁决 B);两文件被删的 4 行(下方表)。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期两条都绿、两文件行数 104 / 82 不变。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地(Tier S,待 review#2 契约复审 PASS 后由席位入队)。

## What changes

The card's three items, in two files of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. The ruling is the maintainer's own words quoted on the card (filing gate ③): 「剩下的p3你都按照这个标准完整的审核一遍吧」. The card body's two lists ("Close as not planned …", "Keep …") are carried item for item, every example kept; neither list is widened or narrowed.

1. **Triage first touch for p3** (`triage-duties.md` grading block). The old line 「缺 `reach:` 且非例外 ⇒ 定 `priority:p3`,并入收口卡或清扫卡,⛔ 不单独派发、不因此关卡。」 becomes the head of the standard: a missing-reach card is still graded p3 and, if kept, still folds into a collecting or sweep card and is never dispatched alone. Its tail 「不因此关卡」 is replaced by the standard, which contradicted it for unmeasured corners. The standard follows on three continuation lines: close as not planned, each card with its own reason, when the work has no customer or user effect (pins only, ADR or jsdoc wording, internal refactors, test-title rewording), is stale, superseded or already delivered, or is a corner no user is measured reaching (two-holder edges, a newline inside a path segment); keep user-visible defects, published docs and skills text, security items, maintainer-directed work, and anything an open PR carries or a seat has taken. Lines 66 and 67 (「无则关」, the tooling close) say neither list, so nothing folded into them.
2. **Filing gate** (`filing-gate.md`). New line 34: a nit or out-of-scope finding that meets the close side is written in the PR's own record and is not filed as a card.
3. **Ruling B** (same line 34, read with lines 35–36 below it): the per-PR `review follow-ups of PR #N` card and the area `AREA loose ends` card take only items that meet the keep side; an empty list means no card. A p3 copy or docs nit with no user effect therefore goes to neither card.

`execution-duties.md` is untouched: it has no line that files an L1/L2 nit or out-of-scope finding. Those filings run through `SKILL.md` (report contract: `filed #N` / Acceptance notes / dropped; the seat files the three classes through the filing gate) and `contract-review.md` (a nit-only round goes to a follow-up card per `filing-gate.md`). Both route through the filing gate, so item 2 lives there once. The seat agreed (thread, 02:56Z).

### Line budget (ratchet headroom 0 on both files; seat-approved payers)

| File | Before → after | Added | Deleted (payer) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `triage-duties.md` | 104 → 104 | 3 continuation lines (line 59 rewritten in place) | 3 |
| `filing-gate.md` | 82 → 82 | 1 (line 34) | 1 (old line 13; old line 14 gains the subject `reach:` it lost) |

Each deleted line and its surviving home (tree at `a7ccc0ee`):

| Deleted line | Home |
|:--|:--|
| triage-duties old 10 「两仓对账兜底:cloud 卡无状态逾 4 h ⇒ 写信 `repo:cloud` 各席 …(`lanes/cloud.md`)」 | `references/lanes/cloud.md:27`, near-verbatim (「兜底:分诊日对账见 cloud 卡无状态逾 4 h ⇒ 写信本车道各席;分诊 ⛔ 不代打标签」); the deleted line pointed there itself. |
| triage-duties old 57 「(c) 元数据 = 由写它的人以外的人存储并再作者化的键 …」 | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:50` (same definition). Class (c) itself stays in triage-duties line 52, and line 50 still points at the filing gate. |
| triage-duties old 37 「分诊定级轮读车道 `Suggested-grade:` 行:是输入不是定级,确认或改判,不采纳给理由。」 | Weak home, as the seat noted: `execution-duties.md:63` defines the line and forbids the lane writing the grade label, and the grade stays triage's alone (`SKILL.md` lane rules); triage's first touch reads the card and its comments, where the line sits. What is lost is the explicit 「不采纳给理由」 for this one line; `execution-duties.md:130` keeps the same discipline for the opposite-direction suggestion line. |
| filing-gate old 13 「`reach:` 二选一:公开入口 … 实测一次错误结果;或具名真实生产者。」 | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:47`, the same two forms. A short pointer did not fit any existing filing-gate line under 120 B, so the old line 14 only gains its subject (`reach:` 两种例外照立 …). |

No security-discipline line was used as a payer. Bytes per changed line against the 120 cap: 120, 108, 119, 120 (triage-duties 56–59); 110, 118 (filing-gate 13, 34).

## Tests

No code changed, so no test or ablation. No forced test edit.

## Acceptance notes

- `ADR or jsdoc wording` is on the close side, while `AGENTS.md` (Context Routing, ruling record 6797014134), `execution-duties.md:112` and `triage-duties.md` line 75 have the landing seat file ADR status-line and bookkeeping cards. This PR reads those as maintainer-directed (a standing ruling orders them) and so kept; nothing was edited for it. Flagged for the contract review.
- `filing-gate.md` line 20 (「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」) still stands for follow-ups that meet the keep side; the new line 34 is narrower and only removes close-side items.
- `triage-duties.md`'s human floor lists a card's fate (closing as not planned) as the maintainer's. The p3 first-touch close applies the maintainer's own standard, and line 84 already lets the maintainer veto and reopen; no edit.
- The card's "Measure" section is untouched; it is triage's to track.
